section_summary: This section handles the core specific features of the application, encompassing the dashboard UI, candidate assessment reporting, and specialized chart components. It provides detailed data visualization and insights for both candidates and reviewers, alongside essential authentication and state management wrappers. Overall, these components form the primary user interface for analyzing interview outcomes and historical trends.
